summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K attaching an RNS announcement of open-market repurchases under a buyback programme announced 21 July 2026. Between 14 and 18 September 2026 the company bought 1,145,131 Class A ordinary shares on London venues (XLON, CHIX, BATE) at volume-weighted prices of roughly GBP 8.69-8.99 and 842,561 Class A shares on Nasdaq at roughly USD 11.58-12.12, executed through Goldman Sachs International and affiliates as riskless principal. Shares repurchased are held in treasury. The programme authorises up to GBP 405 million (about USD 540 million); a detailed trade schedule is annexed and disclosure is made under UK MAR and FCA Listing Rule 14.3.17(2). Watch execution pace against the authorisation cap, buyback price versus intrinsic value, treasury share cancellation policy, and any EPS accretion arithmetic.
